favourite.heading: Why Indiana can pull away
bullets: Indiana is the better football team by 21.3 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+21.3 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Indiana by 4.4 points: ball control vs front disruption (+4.4 pts).
Playing at Indiana is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Northwestern can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +5.8 to p90 +50.8 for Indiana, so a projection of +29.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
